visualCharacteristics.structure: two columns: large featured video testimonial (thumbnail + play button + name/role) left; italic quote, CTA button and 2-up grid of small video testimonials right
visualCharacteristics.summary: Featured video testimonial (large thumbnail with play button, name, role) beside an italic quote, a 'Read more client reviews' button and two smaller video testimonial thumbnails (name, role)

contentPattern.structure: one row per testimonial: thumbnail image | bold name, role paragraph, link to the video (YouTube/Vimeo/mp4); the featured (first) row also carries the quote (blockquote or italic paragraph) and a 'read more' link
